title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop cybersecurity team.

• Coordinate security activities across regional technology teams and businesses.

Security Standards and Compliance

• Implement cybersecurity policies and standards.

• Ensure compliance with relevant local regulations and company requirements.

• Work with Security teams to address regional security needs.

• Ensure global security key indicator thresholds are met.

Risk Management and Security Controls

• Assess cybersecurity risks for new systems, projects and technology changes.

• Review and approve regional security requests and identify non-compliant solutions.

• Monitor security controls, support audits and ensure that identified issues are resolved on time.

• Develop and track action plans to reduce security risks.

• Identify regional opportunities to improve the cybersecurity agenda

Cybersecurity Incident Management

• Act as the central contact between global teams responsible for cybersecurity incident coordination and management and Operating Companies.

• Coordinate the remediation of identified security vulnerabilities.Security owns vulnerability identification and prioritisation; local asset owners are responsible for remediation.

• Support security investigations when required.

Technology and Operational Security

• Provide security guidance, based on security policies, for IT systems, networks and industrial control systems used in production.

• Support effective security practices, including system updates, vulnerability management and access controls.

• Work with technology teams to integrate security requirements into new and existing solutions.

Security Awareness

• Support the delivery of global cybersecurity awareness training tailored to business needs and drive completion.

• Promote good security practices across teams.

Planning and Reporting

• Develop cybersecurity improvement plans and coordinate required resources and budgets.

• Report key security risks, incidents, compliance gaps and improvement progress to management and Security teams.

**Communication and Other Skills**

Communication Skills

• Manage relationships with stakeholders who have conflicting interests; communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.

• Act as the operational link between business stakeholders, including senior leaders, and technical roles in Security.

Other Skills

• Understand the business and the importance of creating value for customers.

• Work collaboratively and navigate complex decision-making.

• Demonstrate experience working in an Agile environment

**Functional Competencies**

• Business analysis: interpret customer needs and convert them into initiatives.

• Project management, strategic planning and resource management.

• Relevant professional qualifications, such as CISSP, CISM, ISSMP, CISA, CIA, CSTA, CSTP, CIIP, CFIP, CSIS, CMI or CWSA, or equivalent.

• Identify and drive opportunities to improve information security efficiency.

• Knowledge of and practical experience with frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27000 series and IEC 62443.

• Experience with business impact assessments and security assessments.

• Act as a cybersecurity ambassador by communicating information security and risk requirements to product teams and global functions.

• Explain cybersecurity governance and processes to business stakeholders.

• Recognize problems, identify possible causes and resolve issues.

• Work effectively with people from different teams and cultures.

• Adapt to multiple demands, changing priorities, ambiguity and rapid change.

• Apply strong analytical and reporting skills.

• Write reports, procedures and policies, and communicate effectively in different situations.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external organisations, teams and individuals.
